notes.title: Update Version 1.1 - QoL & Gameplay Improvements
notes.content:
Change log for version 1.1:

[b]Major Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Item pickups will now display text after being picked up which describes what affect they have
[*] The unlocks/achievements menu has been redesigned to look more appealing and functional
[*] The players movement is no longer connected to gravity. Before, if the player was rising or falling while trying to drag the force arrow, the arrow would move with the player. This is no longer the case and the arrow will stay at the mouse position regardless of movement changes. (also works for controllers)
[*] Improved the tutorial so that it provides more guided information about how to play. (can be disabled from the game settings menu)
[*] Added 5 new tiles to the pool of spawn-able tiles
[*] Created a new obstacle type that both moves and turns on and off over time
[/list]

[b]Minor Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed version number on main menu and in game file settings.
[*] As of version 1.05 achievements are integrated with Steam
[*] Controls can be viewed during gameplay through the How To Play screen on the pause menu (binding information will update based on what device is being used)
[*] Some game settings in the options menu were not resetting to defaults properly, this is now fixed
[*] When a controller is connected a UI element will automatically be selected so that a mouse and keyboard is not needed to interact with menus
[*] Fixed an issue where the "launch player" input field in the options menu would not become active when it was supposed to
[*] The mouse will now automatically hide when a controller is in use
[*] The game will now pause whenever the current input device is lost or disconnected
[*] Adjusted layout of some currently existing tiles
[/list]

This is the first major update since the release of Rise 2.0. Changes and improvements for this update are based on things I planned on adding or feedback I got from the community. If you have any feedback of your own to give please leave a review for the game or create a post on the community. I hope you enjoy the changes!

notes.title: Update Version 1.05 - Steam Achievements Integration
notes.content:
Added functionality that allows for in-game achievements to sync and update with Steam servers. Achievements should now work and be fully unlock-able.

Please let me know if you run into any issues with achievements in the future and I will update the game to fix any problems.

notes.title: Added private build for testing features.
notes.content: - Setup a private build to test live changes to steam features.

notes.title: Rise 2.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
I'm excited that Rise 2.0 is finally on Steam. It's really cool to see my game on this platform but I just wanted to leave an announcement for everyone. The game in its current state is fully functional and plays just how I intended it to BUT the Steam side of the functionality is not there right now. Please understand that if you buy and play Rise 2.0 today you will see that:

[list]
[*] Cloud saves are not implemented
[*] The Steam overlay will not pause the game when activated
[*] Achievements will not be unlocked on steam, only in the game
[/list]

I understand that there may also be some issues related to controller use with menus along with some other minor bugs. These and the Steam issues will be solved in the near future but I cannot give a date as to when. I plan to continue working on improving the game after release and depending on recommendations from the community, I may even add new features as time goes on.

I hope that you enjoy Rise 2.0. Thanks for reading.
